content:
Hi, I am a mathematician working at Handshake AI as a project lead. We are currently looking to hire people with strong Lean experience for a project focused on improving how AI models translate natural-language mathematical statements into Lean accurately and faithfully. We are a very socially active group of academics and industry folks and there are no AI interviews for this opportunity.

The work will involve model stumping, reviewing translations,
and helping develop or evaluate training data. We are still scoping the exact structure of the project, so details may evolve.

Pay is $125/hour. Please message me directly if you are interested, with a brief description of your mathematical/lean area of expertise.
